title: Why I sold my car
instructions: Paul arabasını neden sattığını anlatıyor. Sebeplere ve şimdi nasıl yolculuk ettiğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last year, I sold my car.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Petrol and parking were too expensive, and I was always stuck in traffic.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Now I go to work by bike. It takes twenty-five minutes.

script.speaker: s
script.text: When it rains, I take the bus.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I save about two hundred pounds a month, and I'm much fitter!

questions.prompt: Why did Paul sell his car?
options: It was expensive and he was always in traffic.
questions.feedback: Benzin ve otopark pahalıydı, hep trafikteydi.
questions.evidence: Petrol and parking were too expensive
